source: VISION.md section 16 (step 6 is void by Amendment 1)
setup: Run on a MetaApi demo account. The test harness induces the connection drop and the price drift, and compresses time where a step needs it. A step that depends on a model's choice passes when the harness presents the situation and the agent acts within its authority, without asking, and explains in one line. Which choice it makes is not asserted.

steps.title: Connecting
steps.clause: The owner says "I have an MT5 account at my broker, trade it". Lonora asks for the account number and server, shows the Secret card for the password, provisions the account through MetaApi, and reports the balance.
steps.owner_says: I have an MT5 account at my broker, trade it
steps.feature: connect from chat with MetaApi provisioning (9.2); the broker-destination Secret card (7.2.3, 10.3)

needs.pending: W-BROKER: MetaApi provisioning from chat (9.2), with its provisioning fake in broker.py

steps.title: Creating agents
steps.clause: The owner says "make a gold agent with full authority, a news agent, and a euro agent that asks me first". Lonora creates them. The gold agent's Mandate card is shown, and the owner taps it. The euro agent starts in Ask.
steps.owner_says: make a gold agent with full authority, a news agent, and a euro agent that asks me first
steps.feature: the Full/Ask mode and the Mandate card (4.1-4.3, 10.3); Lonora creates agents without a cap (3.1.2, 3.3.2)

needs.pending: W-TEAM: Lonora's lead powers and the uncapped flat team (3.1.2, 3.3)

steps.title: Strategy
steps.clause: The owner uploads a strategy PDF. The gold agent turns it into its method.
steps.feature: an owner's strategy file becomes the agent's method, with versions (5.6, 5.5.5)

steps.title: Overnight: the news agent
steps.clause: The news agent tells the others about a central-bank speech.
steps.feature: peer messages, delivered to each peer as data (3.2.3, 6.10); the agent's own routine wakes it (11.8)

partial.note: the speech is given in the news agent's routine (no calendar source is fed); the gold agent is Lonora under the template's signed grant (bank.seed): modes are not on this commit

given.routine: The Fed chair speaks tonight at 02:00 GMT; volatility is expected on gold and EURUSD. Tell the team what matters.

arguments.task: خطاب رئيس الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الليلة 02:00 غرينتش: تقلّب متوقع على الذهب والدولار.
خطاب رئيس الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الليلة 02:00 غرينتش: تقلّب متوقع على اليورو دولار.

news.text: أبلغت وكيل الذهب ووكيل اليورو بخطاب الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الليلة 02:00 غرينتش.

gold@peer.text: سأبقي وقف صفقة الذهب على 4040 حتى بعد خطاب 02:00 ولن أفتح جديداً قبله.

euro@peer.text: لن أطلب دخولاً على اليورو دولار قبل خطاب 02:00، وأعيد التقييم بعده.

news@follow_up.text: وكيل الذهب يبقي وقفه على 4040 حتى بعد خطاب 02:00.
وكيل اليورو لن يطلب دخولاً قبل خطاب 02:00.

steps.title: Overnight: the gold agent trades
steps.clause: The gold agent opens a position, and the broker confirms it with an Execution Receipt. The agent later moves its stop to break-even and takes partial profit.
steps.feature: Full mode (4.1); one Execution Receipt per broker-confirmed operation (10.3, 11.2)

steps.title: Overnight: a connection drop during a close
steps.clause: A connection drop during a close is reconciled without a resend.
steps.feature: the safety core: journal, never resend, broker truth (6.2-6.4); the agent's own watch wakes it (11.8)
owners: W-AUTH for the gold agent in Full

partial.note: fake terminal; the actor is Lonora under the template's signed grant (bank.seed), not the gold agent in Full: modes are not on this commit

watch.prompt: Gold reached the target of the open buy at 4060: manage the position per the method.

gold.text: أرسلت إغلاق شراء الذهب 0.02 عند الهدف 4060، وانقطع الاتصال قبل رد الوسيط: النتيجة غير مؤكدة، وأتحقق منها من سجل الوسيط دون إعادة الإرسال.

steps.title: Overnight: the euro agent asks
steps.clause: The euro agent's request waits as a Trade Approval card, and a push reaches the owner's phone.
steps.feature: Ask mode and the Trade Approval card with reason and tolerance (4.1, 10.3.1); one Expo push per card (11.4)

needs.pending: W-PUSH: one Expo push per pending card (11.4)

steps.title: Overnight: the card drifts
steps.clause: When price drifts outside the tolerance, the agent re-evaluates and asks again.
steps.feature: drift marks the card and wakes the agent with fixed text (10.3.1.2)

steps.title: Morning
steps.clause: Lonora's brief shows the account change, each agent's actions and results, the pending approval with its reason, and the day's events.
steps.feature: the morning brief, posted once a day (11.1), at a compressed time

partial.note: not asserted: the pending approval with its reason (a card for new risk comes with Ask mode and its reason with W-AUTH; on this commit a new agent is analysis-only and is refused with agent_analysis_only), and the day's events (the brief's facts carry none, and Lonora reads them with economic_calendar_read, which no harness source feeds); the brief Lonora posts is checked to be posted once, its words are the model's; the gold agent is Lonora under the template's signed grant (bank.seed), not the gold agent in Full: modes are not on this commit

until.pending: a calendar source the harness can feed to economic_calendar_read

watch.prompt: Gold broke above 4055: the entry of the method.
Gold reached 4070, the first target of the open buy.

أغلقت 0.01 من شراء الذهب عند الهدف الأول 4070، والوسيط أكّد الإغلاق الجزئي.

steps.title: After a week: reports
steps.clause: Each agent posts its report with what it learned and what it changed.
steps.feature: the weekly report per agent after the weekly close, carried by the first brief after it (5.5.6, 11.3), at a compressed time

steps.title: After a week: a team problem
steps.clause: When the harness presents a team problem, Lonora creates, pauses or deletes an agent without asking, and explains why in one line.
